The positive arm is the same root at 84457822bb, where init returns rc=0 and the plan evaluates the selector and renders 242 resource changes. A second, independent control guards the live-absence reading of the break-glass role: get-role on the role returns NoSuchEntity while an ISOLATED get-role on demo-transform-runner-ec2-role returns its ARN under the same credentials, so the absence is the world and not the instrument. The two live-read controls must DISCRIMINATE: an absent role and an existing role must read differently under the same credentials, and an existing-but-forbidden bucket must read differently from a truly absent one.
mutant.observed: All three fired. (1) Base 28fbb42d46: init rc=1 with 'Invalid value for "list" parameter' at s3-lgic-firm-buckets.tf line 197, while 84457822bb init rc=0 and the plan renders 242 resource changes -- the arms differ. (2) get-role on the break-glass role -> NoSuchEntity; isolated get-role on demo-transform-runner-ec2-role -> its ARN. In-plan corroboration: 14 of 15 aws_iam_role rows read no-op. A first attempt at control (2) used a guessed role name, opal-demo-transform-runner, which does not exist and returned NoSuchEntity; it was discarded as non-discriminating and re-run on the real name read out of the plan's prior state. The discarded attempt is named because a non-discriminating control that is quietly dropped is how a false absence survives.
